name: panel-grid
title: Panel Grid
description: A 12-column dashboard grid that responds to its own width, not the viewport's, so it works the same in a sidebar layout, a dialog or a full page. Children choose their columns with `data-span` (wide containers) and `data-span-md` (medium); `Panel` sets both from its `span` props. Below 40rem every child takes the full row. Server-safe.
